integrity: An analytical proof and standalone exact symbolic checker support the claimed statements. Finite sampling is only corroborative; historical mathematical equivalence beyond inspected primary literature is possible. Independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Real Haar orthogonal Grassmannians, fourth moments of centered linear trace observables, all dimensions n>=2 and ranks 1<=k<n; exact extremizer classification for n>=4. No assertions for complex fields, non-Haar laws, higher moments or nonlinear observables. The B=0 formula is conditional, without an integer-solution claim.
title: Rank-dependent fourth-moment reversal on real Grassmannians
